title: ITiCSE 2026 WG10: Teamwork in Computing Education — Skills, Values, and Virtues
description: Materials, data, and tools produced by ITiCSE 2026 Working Group 10 (WG10), examining how tertiary computing programs can effectively integrate teamwork instruction, with a focus on the skills, values, and virtues students need throughout collaborative projects. Includes a systematic literature review of teamwork in computing and engineering education, screening and data-extraction tables, and the tooling used to run the review.
